name: Sim(3) Alignment via Procrustes Analysis
definition: A method to align estimated camera poses to ground truth by computing a 3D similarity transformation (Sim(3)) using Procrustes analysis on camera pose locations.
summary: Sim(3) Alignment via Procrustes Analysis computes a 3D similarity transformation to align camera poses by minimizing distances between corresponding centers, distinguishing itself from PCA alignment by explicitly solving for rotation, translation, and scale.
